name: 98th Academy Awards
description: The 98th Academy Awards, hosted by Conan O'Brien at the Dolby Theatre, Hollywood on March 15, 2026. Honoring the best films of 2025. Sinners leads with a record 16 nominations.

categories.name: Best Picture
categories.description: Awarded to the producers of the best film of the year.

contestants.name: Bugonia
contestants.description: Directed by Yorgos Lanthimos. Producers: Ed Guiney, Andrew Lowe, Yorgos Lanthimos, Emma Stone, Lars Knudsen.

contestants.name: One Battle After Another

contestants.name: Sentimental Value
